mathematical_convention.G1_G2: Continuous drift derivatives with respect to effective financial theta; no dt included.
mathematical_convention.K_drive_K_condition: Continuous lower drift derivatives with respect to the two copies of the same numerical margin link.
mathematical_convention.A_B: Discrete Euler local Jacobians. All cross/parameter blocks include dt exactly once.
mathematical_convention.D1_D2: Diagonal elements of d(theta_i)/d(raw_i), returned as [batch,9], using actual recorded tanh values.
mathematical_convention.boundary_raw1_drive_boundary_raw1_condit: UNMASKED direct lower-state vs raw1 blocks, shape [batch,2,9], including dt. They expose the explicit -b1_theta/b1 path separately from upper-state history.
mathematical_convention.mode: Only cross-state/lower-raw1 blocks are masked; same-value feature inputs and own-layer/raw2 derivatives remain unchanged.
mathematical_convention.precision: FP64 composition at represented input/intermediate values; scalar configuration coefficients are converted once to FP32. No differentiation of rounding or higher derivatives.

synthetic_checks: All four gradient modes compared against central finite differences of arbitrary smooth NONFINANCIAL field compositions, with detached edges represented by frozen local anchor links.
Same numerical forward values; explicit boundary component sums, both-detached layer1 zero VJP, full=drive+conditioning layer1 decomposition and invariant layer2 VJP.
Reverse accumulation independently compared with forward state/parameter sensitivity propagation.
limits: Financial raw values/Jacobians are supplied by the caller; this module is not a financial oracle.
Synthetic checks establish chain construction, dimensions, transpose direction and dt placement, not an actual two-layer financial outcome.
Nonzero boundary or conditioning VJPs establish graph routes, not useful pulse dynamics, time-varying financial PDE solutions, quality or efficiency.
